Eliza Perlman is a Space Federation Army Lieutenant for the New Solar faction.

One of the two heroines of Prison Academia. She holds the rank of First Lieutenant, during the main events of the visual novel. Her legal name is Eliza Barrault.


Personality

Eliza has a cheerful personality, which makes her very popular among her colleagues. She is far more simple and direct in her approach to conflict, to the point of being neglectful. Often viewed as a more brutish monster which loves to fight. During the Hermes Conflict, she became acquainted with Julia and formed a deep bond of trust with her. She shows off her passionate side to those around her by sending emails every day and carrying photos with her.

She is a great friend of Julia Bloodstone.

Appearance
She has long golden silver hair and blue eyes. Eliza has a slender figure with an amber bust and curvy legs.

History
Background
Born in the year 2231, of the powerful Pearlman family.

Eliza comes from a family of politicians and business leaders, as such there was never a need for her to join the army, but she desired to do so herself. Although, Eliza decides to strive off on her own and became a soldier for the Universal Federation Army. She becomes a member of the New Solar faction, and a friend of, at the time, First lieutenant, Julia Bloodstone.

Eliza was a Sergeant major during the "Hermes Conflict", fighting for the New Solars on her Sleipnir (Artificial). In the year, 2251, she joined Julia, as she rejected the plans of the higher ups and freed her from military confinement after all higher ranking officers had fled. Thanks to Julia's strategy, commanded a troop of 2000 soldiers, and defeated 8000 soldiers, during a counter-attack defending Fortress Hel-Verdun. She would kill the enemy commander Joseph Hummel of the Neo Terra and was secretly tasked to also kill the New Solar Comander-in-Chief General Mari Valmer, which had attempted to escape but now was held in the enemy HQ. Thanks to this victory, the New Solars, on planet Hermes were able to push away the New Solars. Both her and Julia Bloodstone became known as heroes, with her being known as the Reaper of the Snow.

Eliza had been dating a male soldier, William Barrow, since year 2254 and recently got married 3 months prior to the start of Prison Academia, in year 2256. Eliza's legal surname is "Barrault", but prefers to be called by her maiden name for military related duties. After Julia's promotion to commander, Eliza agrees to serve under Julia's leadership and accompanied her when Julia was given control of her own battleship. She also followed her to the Military Academy, as a special academic instructor and the rank of First Lieutenant.

Visual Novels
In the year 2256, on November 22nd on the 30th anniversary of the first shared attempt of settlement on Hermes, now 5 years after the Hermes Conflict, Julia and Eliza were meant to perform a speech.

Eliza became a target of Albert Payne a Neo Terran. In the end, her personality was deleted by his Brainwashing Machine (Prison), which he obtained by a mysterious benefactor. Eliza broke contact with her former lover, which survived a failed attempt to retake control of Hermes. Julia and Eliza would proclaim the independence of Hermes, and became the official faces of the Hermes Liberation Army, as they revealed the crimes performed, New Solar reaction was cautious.

Timeline TABA
Recordings of the exploits of Albert Payne are sent back in time around 200 years because of an unknown coalition within the solar system. The Fuuma Organization is able to catch encoded data the UFS has collected, and Fuuma Kotaro (TABA) watches the torture of Julia Bloodstone and Eliza Perlman.
